observed_evidence.pr_create_error: GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests (createPullRequest)

root_cause: The original source monitor computes and promotes content hash changes for non-authoritative HTTP 202/HTML anti-bot responses. The original writer's built-in GitHub Actions token cannot open a PR under the current repository policy; that is a distinct security boundary and must not be bypassed or falsely called live.
fix: Classify any status other than HTTP 200, empty response, and recognizable HTML challenge as UNVERIFIED; retain previous legal source-state baseline, store diagnosis/raw bytes separately in the existing Brain ingestion, and mark freshness_heartbeat true only on a trusted authoritative response. No new writer, cron or provider.
prevention: Treat source HTTP acceptance/challenge as source health, not legal text change; only validated HTTP 200 authoritative content may advance the source baseline. Preserve existing GitHub permission boundary and put any legitimate source-change PR through an approved repository owner. Do not merge HTTP202 candidate branch.
